title: ha-notice config
description: Merged config after config.yaml and config.d/*.yaml. Self-contained. There are no environment overrides. base_url and service have no default and are required for a send; they are not required here because a drop-in may hold one of them and the tool checks after merging.

base_url.description: https://host[:port][/prefix] (one trailing slash run allowed, removed by the tool); http:// only with allow_insecure_http: true. No userinfo, query, fragment, empty or dot segment; non-ASCII hosts as punycode. The port is a number from 1 to 65535, written with at most 5 digits (leading zeros allowed, kept as written). The tool also requires the text between brackets of an IPv6 host to be a valid IPv6 address; the pattern is looser.

service.description: The notify service name (the part after notify.), for example a mobile_app_ service.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the token; restricted to HA_ names.

ca_file.description: Extra CA bundle, an absolute path (no ~). The tool checks that it is a readable regular file of at most 4 MiB. Added to a non-empty default trust; the whole trust when the default trust is empty.

link_hosts.description: Allowed link hosts: at least two labels each, lowercase, no leading or trailing dot (equal or dot-suffix match). Unset by default.

info.description: One line, at most 16 characters; the tool also refuses a value the sanitizer would change.

warn.description: One line, at most 16 characters; the tool also refuses a value the sanitizer would change.

action.description: One line, at most 16 characters; the tool also refuses a value the sanitizer would change.

error.description: One line, at most 16 characters; the tool also refuses a value the sanitizer would change.

timeout.description: The one deadline of a send, 1s to 120s (range checked by the tool).

connect_timeout.description: Limit for the connect phase, 1s to 30s (range checked by the tool); never longer than the time that remains in the deadline.

duration.description: A number of seconds or a string <number>(ms|s|m) with no unit meaning seconds. The range of each key is in its description and is checked by the tool.
